title: Windows Error 0x80070005
problem: Access denied error when installing software.
solution: 1. Run installer as administrator. 2. Check folder permissions. 3. Disable antivirus temporarily.

title: WiFi Connected but No Internet
problem: Connected to WiFi but cannot browse websites.
solution: 1. Restart router. 2. Run ipconfig /flushdns. 3. Reset network settings.

title: Python ModuleNotFoundError
problem: ModuleNotFoundError when running Python script.
solution: 1. Install module using pip install <module>. 2. Activate correct virtual environment.

title: Windows Blue Screen Error (BSOD)
problem: System crashes and shows blue screen with stop code.
solution: 1. Note the stop code. 2. Update drivers. 3. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic. 4. Check for hardware issues.

title: Disk Usage 100% in Task Manager
problem: Computer becomes very slow and disk usage shows 100%.
solution: 1. Disable Windows Search service. 2. Check for malware. 3. Upgrade to SSD. 4. Update storage drivers.

title: Printer Not Responding
problem: Printer is connected but not printing documents.
solution: 1. Restart printer. 2. Check printer queue. 3. Reinstall printer drivers. 4. Ensure printer is set as default.

title: DNS Server Not Responding
problem: Internet connected but cannot resolve websites.
solution: 1. Change DNS to 8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4. 2. Restart router. 3. Flush DNS cache.

title: Laptop Overheating
problem: Laptop becomes hot and shuts down automatically.
solution: 1. Clean internal fans. 2. Replace thermal paste. 3. Use cooling pad. 4. Check background processes.

title: Microsoft Teams Not Opening
problem: Teams application crashes on startup.
solution: 1. Clear Teams cache. 2. Reinstall application. 3. Update Windows. 4. Check firewall settings.

title: Slow Internet Speed
problem: Internet works but speed is very low.
solution: 1. Restart router. 2. Move closer to router. 3. Check bandwidth usage. 4. Upgrade internet plan.

title: USB Device Not Recognized
problem: USB device is plugged in but not detected.
solution: 1. Try different USB port. 2. Update USB drivers. 3. Restart computer. 4. Check device compatibility.

title: Outlook Not Sending Emails
problem: Emails stay in outbox and are not delivered.
solution: 1. Check internet connection. 2. Verify SMTP settings. 3. Disable offline mode. 4. Repair Outlook profile.

title: Google Chrome Crashing
problem: Chrome browser closes unexpectedly.
solution: 1. Disable extensions. 2. Clear cache. 3. Update Chrome. 4. Reinstall browser.

title: Windows Update Stuck
problem: Windows update freezes during installation.
solution: 1. Restart PC. 2. Run Windows Update Troubleshooter. 3. Clear SoftwareDistribution folder. 4. Retry update.

title: No Sound from Speakers
problem: System audio not working even though volume is up.
solution: 1. Check default playback device. 2. Update audio drivers. 3. Restart Windows Audio service.

title: VPN Not Connecting
problem: VPN fails to establish secure connection.
solution: 1. Check internet connection. 2. Verify login credentials. 3. Change VPN protocol. 4. Disable firewall temporarily.

title: Hard Drive Not Detected
problem: System BIOS does not detect internal hard drive.
solution: 1. Check SATA cables. 2. Enter BIOS and enable drive. 3. Replace faulty hard drive.

title: Excel File Not Opening
problem: Excel crashes when opening a file.
solution: 1. Open in safe mode. 2. Disable add-ins. 3. Repair Office installation.

title: Network Adapter Missing
problem: Network adapter not visible in Device Manager.
solution: 1. Restart computer. 2. Update network drivers. 3. Enable adapter in BIOS.

title: High CPU Usage
problem: CPU usage remains high even when idle.
solution: 1. Check Task Manager for heavy processes. 2. Scan for malware. 3. Disable startup programs.
